items.followUp: Write two symptoms of peptic ulcer.

rubric.why: Abdominal pain or burning is one symptom of an ulcer.
rubric.description: Names abdominal or stomach pain or burning.
rubric.how: Award this mark for a valid pain or burning symptom.

rubric.why: Nausea, vomiting and indigestion are possible ulcer symptoms.
rubric.how: Award this mark for a valid symptom different from the one credited in the first point; do not award twice for repeating the same symptom.

modelAnswer: A person with an ulcer may have pain or a burning sensation in the abdomen.
Other symptoms may include nausea, vomiting or indigestion.

items.followUp: Give two differences between arteries and veins.

rubric.why: Arteries and veins carry blood in opposite directions relative to the heart.
rubric.description: Contrasts the directions of blood flow in arteries and veins.
rubric.how: Check that the answer assigns flow away from the heart to arteries and flow towards the heart to veins.

rubric.why: Arteries have thicker, more elastic walls, while veins have thinner walls; veins also have valves.
rubric.description: Gives a structural contrast between arteries and veins.
rubric.how: Award for a correctly assigned contrast in wall thickness or elasticity, or for identifying valves in veins.

modelAnswer: Arteries carry blood away from the heart, whereas veins carry blood towards the heart.
Arteries have thick, elastic walls; veins have thinner walls and valves.

items.followUp: Name one Muslim scientist who contributed to biology and describe his contribution.

rubric.why: Biology is the study of life and living organisms.
rubric.description: Defines biology as the study of life or living organisms.
rubric.how: Check that the definition identifies life or living organisms as the subject of biology.

rubric.why: Bu Ali Sina contributed to medicine and wrote Al-Qanun fi al-Tibb.
rubric.description: Names Bu Ali Sina and a contribution to medicine.
rubric.how: Check for the scientist's name together with his medical work or contribution.

rubric.why: Abdul Malik Asmai studied and wrote about animals.
rubric.description: Names Abdul Malik Asmai and his work on animals.
rubric.how: Check for his name together with animals or an animal group he wrote about.

rubric.description: Names Ibn al-Nafis and his description of pulmonary circulation.
rubric.how: Check for his name together with pulmonary or lung circulation.

modelAnswer: Biology is the study of life and living organisms.
Bu Ali Sina wrote Al-Qanun fi al-Tibb, an important medical work.
Abdul Malik Asmai wrote about animals, including horses and camels.
